source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Log all data into the vehicle inspection report.
3. Document the nature of the brake failure.
4. Detail the testing conditions.
5. State the measured values.
6. Include the accepted limits and standards.
7. Analyze and conclude.
8. Recommendations.
9. Proper certifications and signatures.

These are the important aspects of documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report. Completing these steps will help to identify the issue, and maintain awareness of the service performed. 

For further information, see: [https://www.fleetio.com/blog/documenting-failed-brake-tests/](https://www.fleetio.com/blog/documenting-failed-brake-tests/)
<end_of_turn>
